data.name: Repository_DatabaseType_Title
data.value: Repository - DatabaseType

data.name: Repository_DatabaseType_Description
data.value: The database engine used for the migration repository. Options: SqlServer, PostgreSQL, MariaDb, MySql, Sqlite.

data.name: Repository_DatabaseType_ValidValues
data.value: SqlServer | PostgreSQL | MariaDb | MySql | Sqlite

data.name: Repository_DatabaseType_DefaultValue
data.value: SqlServer

data.name: Repository_ConnectionString_Title
data.value: Repository - ConnectionString

data.name: Repository_ConnectionString_Description
data.value: Connection string to the repository database. Use {ENV:VAR_NAME} placeholders for sensitive values like passwords.

data.name: Repository_ConnectionString_Examples
data.value: Server=myserver;Database=RayMigratorRepo;User Id=sa;Password={ENV:REPO_PASSWORD}; For Sqlite: Data Source=./raymigrator.db

data.name: Repository_SchemaName_Title
data.value: Repository - SchemaName

data.name: Repository_SchemaName_Description
data.value: Database schema where repository tables are created. The schema will be created automatically if it does not exist. Not applicable for Sqlite.

data.value: ray

data.name: Repository_SchemaName_InheritanceNote
data.value: Not applicable for Sqlite. For SQL Server and PostgreSQL the schema is created automatically if it does not exist.

data.name: Repository_TableBaseName_Title
data.value: Repository - TableBaseName

data.name: Repository_TableBaseName_Description
data.value: Prefix for all repository table names. Helps with sorting and displaying database objects when the migration repository resides in the same schema as your application tables. For example, a prefix like 'RM_' groups all RayMigrator tables together in database management tools.

data.name: Repository_TableBaseName_Examples
data.value: If set to 'App1_', tables will be named App1_MigrationRun, App1_Migration, etc. Useful when sharing a schema between multiple RayMigrator instances.

data.name: Repository_Timeout_Title
data.value: Repository - Timeout

data.name: Repository_Timeout_Description
data.value: Database command timeout in seconds for repository operations. Default: 60.

data.name: Repository_MaxRetries_Title
data.value: Repository - Max Retries

data.name: Repository_MaxRetries_Description
data.value: Maximum retry attempts for transient errors during repository operations. Default: 100.

data.name: Repository_MaxRetries_InheritanceNote
data.value: High default (100) because the repository must be available before migrations can start. The wait between retries is controlled by the Wait Time setting.

data.name: Repository_Wait_Title
data.value: Repository - Wait

data.name: Repository_Wait_Description
data.value: Wait time in milliseconds before retrying a failed repository operation. Default: 250.

data.name: DatabaseLogging_Enable_Title

data.name: DatabaseLogging_Enable_Description
data.value: Enables or disables database logging. When enabled, RayMigrator writes log entries to a database table.

data.value: true (recommended)

data.name: DatabaseLogging_DatabaseType_ValidValues
data.value: SqlServer | PostgreSQL | MariaDb | MySql | Sqlite

data.value: Same as Repository

data.name: DatabaseLogging_DatabaseType_InheritanceNote

data.name: DatabaseLogging_ConnectionString_Title

data.name: DatabaseLogging_ConnectionString_Examples

data.name: DatabaseLogging_SchemaName_Title

data.name: DatabaseLogging_SchemaName_DefaultValue
data.value: ray

data.name: DatabaseLogging_MinimumLevel_Title
data.value: Database Logging - MinimumLevel

data.name: DatabaseLogging_MinimumLevel_Description
data.value: Minimum log level to write to the database. Options: Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical, None.

data.name: DatabaseLogging_MinimumLevel_ValidValues
data.value: Trace | Debug | Information | Warning | Error | Critical | None

data.name: DatabaseLogging_MinimumLevel_DefaultValue
data.value: Information

data.name: DatabaseLogging_MinimumLevel_Examples
data.value: Trace: All log events including SQL statements Debug: Detailed diagnostic information Information: General operational events (recommended) Warning: Unexpected but non-critical events Error: Errors that prevent a single migration from completing Critical: Errors that stop the entire migration run None: Disables database logging

data.name: DatabaseLogging_Timeout_Title
data.value: Database Logging - Timeout

data.name: DatabaseLogging_Timeout_Description
data.value: Database command timeout in seconds for log writes. Default: 20.

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationErrorAction_Title
data.value: Product Defaults - MigrationErrorAction

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationErrorAction_Description
data.value: What happens when a migration script fails. Options: Terminate, Rollback, RollbackErrorOnly, RollbackRelease, Ignore. Default: Terminate.

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationErrorAction_ValidValues
data.value: Terminate | Rollback | RollbackErrorOnly | RollbackRelease | Ignore

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationErrorAction_DefaultValue
data.value: Terminate

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationErrorAction_Examples
data.value: Terminate: Stop the entire migration run immediately. No rollback is attempted. Rollback: Roll back ALL successfully migrated files in the current run, then stop. RollbackErrorOnly: Roll back only the failed migration file, then stop. RollbackRelease: Roll back all migrations within the failed release only, then stop. Ignore: Log the error and continue with the next migration file.

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationErrorAction_InheritanceNote
data.value: This is the global default. Can be overridden per Product. The effective value flows down to all TargetGroups and Targets within the Product.

data.name: ProductDefaults_RollbackErrorAction_Title
data.value: Product Defaults - RollbackErrorAction

data.name: ProductDefaults_RollbackErrorAction_Description
data.value: What happens when a rollback script fails. Options: Terminate, Ignore. Default: Terminate.

data.name: ProductDefaults_RollbackErrorAction_ValidValues
data.value: Terminate | Ignore

data.name: ProductDefaults_RollbackErrorAction_DefaultValue
data.value: Terminate

data.name: ProductDefaults_RollbackErrorAction_Examples
data.value: Terminate: If a rollback script fails, stop the entire run immediately. Ignore: Log the rollback error and continue rolling back remaining files.

data.name: ProductDefaults_RollbackErrorAction_InheritanceNote
data.value: This is the global default. Can be overridden per Product.

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationFilesExtension_Title
data.value: Product Defaults - MigrationFilesExtension

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationFilesExtension_Description
data.value: File extension for migration scripts. Default: sql.

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationFilesExtension_DefaultValue
data.value: sql

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationFilesExtension_ValidValues
data.value: Any file extension without dot (e.g., sql, ddl, migration)

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationFilesExtension_Examples
data.value: sql (default for all database types)

data.name: ProductDefaults_RollbackFilesPreExtension_Title
data.value: Product Defaults - RollbackFilesPreExtension

data.name: ProductDefaults_RollbackFilesPreExtension_Description
data.value: Pre-extension for rollback script files. Example: 001_CreateUsers.rollback.sql. Default: rollback.

data.name: ProductDefaults_RollbackFilesPreExtension_DefaultValue
data.value: rollback

data.name: ProductDefaults_RollbackFilesPreExtension_Examples
data.value: With default 'rollback' and extension 'sql': Migration: 001_CreateUsers.sql Rollback: 001_CreateUsers.rollback.sql

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationFilesEncoding_Title
data.value: Product Defaults - MigrationFilesEncoding

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationFilesEncoding_Description
data.value: Character encoding for reading migration files. Default: UTF-8.

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationFilesEncoding_DefaultValue
data.value: UTF-8

data.name: ProductDefaults_MigrationFilesEncoding_ValidValues
data.value: UTF-8 | UTF-8-BOM | ASCII | UTF-16 | UTF-32

data.name: ProductDefaults_RequireRollbackFile_Title
data.value: Product Defaults - RequireRollbackFile

data.name: ProductDefaults_RequireRollbackFile_Description
data.value: Whether every migration file must have a corresponding rollback file. Default: true.

data.name: ProductDefaults_RequireRollbackFile_DefaultValue
data.value: true

data.name: ProductDefaults_RequireRollbackFile_InheritanceNote
data.value: When true, every migration file must have a corresponding rollback file or the validation will fail. Can be overridden per Product.

data.name: ProductDefaults_StopRollbackOnMissingRollbackFile_Title
data.value: Product Defaults - StopRollbackOnMissingRollbackFile

data.name: ProductDefaults_StopRollbackOnMissingRollbackFile_Description
data.value: When true, a rollback operation stops if a rollback file is missing for a migration. When false, the migration is skipped and rollback continues. Default: true.

data.name: ProductDefaults_StopRollbackOnMissingRollbackFile_DefaultValue
data.value: true

data.name: ProductDefaults_StopRollbackOnMissingRollbackFile_InheritanceNote
data.value: Can be overridden per Product or per TargetGroup. When RequireRollbackFile is true, this setting is less relevant because missing rollback files are caught during validation.

data.name: ProductDefaults_TargetMigrationOrder_Title
data.value: Product Defaults - TargetMigrationOrder

data.name: ProductDefaults_TargetMigrationOrder_Description
data.value: Execution order for targets within a target group. Simultaneously: file-first. Successively: target-first. Default: Successively.

data.name: ProductDefaults_TargetMigrationOrder_ValidValues
data.value: Simultaneously | Successively

data.name: ProductDefaults_TargetMigrationOrder_DefaultValue
data.value: Successively

data.name: ProductDefaults_TargetMigrationOrder_Examples
data.value:
Simultaneously (file-first): For each migration file, apply it to ALL targets in the group before moving to the next file. File1 -> Target1, Target2, Target3 File2 -> Target1, Target2, Target3
Successively (target-first): For each target, apply ALL migration files before moving to the next target. Target1 -> File1, File2, File3 Target2 -> File1, File2, File3

data.name: ProductDefaults_TargetMigrationOrder_InheritanceNote
data.value: This is the global default for all TargetGroups. Can be overridden per TargetGroup.

data.name: ProductDefaults_HashValidationScope_Title
data.value: Product Defaults - HashValidationScope

data.name: ProductDefaults_HashValidationScope_Description
data.value: Granularity of hash validation. File: one hash per file. SqlBlocks: one hash per SQL block. Disabled: no validation. Default: File.

data.name: ProductDefaults_HashValidationScope_ValidValues
data.value: File | SqlBlocks | Disabled

data.name: ProductDefaults_HashValidationScope_DefaultValue
data.value: File

data.name: ProductDefaults_HashValidationScope_Examples
data.value:
File: One SHA-256 hash is computed over the entire migration file content. Any change to the file will be detected.
SqlBlocks: A hash is computed per SQL statement block (separated by GO for SQL Server, or ; for other engines). This allows adding new blocks at the end without invalidating existing hashes.
Disabled: No hash validation. Use with caution -- changes to already-applied migrations will not be detected.

data.name: ProductDefaults_HashValidationScope_InheritanceNote
data.value: This is the global default for all TargetGroups. Can be overridden per TargetGroup.

data.name: ProductDefaults_UseCliToolAlias_Title
data.value: Product Defaults - UseCliToolAlias

data.name: ProductDefaults_UseCliToolAlias_Description
data.value: Default CLI tool alias for all products. References a CLI tool defined in the CliTools section. Can be overridden per product, target group, or target.

data.name: ProductDefaults_UseCliToolAlias_DefaultValue
data.value: null (use built-in database driver)

data.name: ProductDefaults_UseCliToolAlias_InheritanceNote
data.value: References a CLI tool defined in the CLI Tools section. When set, migrations are executed via the external tool instead of RayMigrator's built-in ADO.NET driver. Inheritance chain: ProductDefaults -> Product -> TargetGroup -> Target (most specific wins).

data.name: Product_Alias_Title
data.value: Product - Alias

data.name: Product_Alias_Description
data.value: Unique name identifying this product. Used in CLI commands to select which product to migrate.

data.name: Product_Alias_Examples
data.value: MyApp, BackendService, DataWarehouse

data.name: Product_Alias_InheritanceNote
data.value: Used in CLI commands: raymigrator migrate-up --product MyApp

data.name: Product_MigrationFilesRootDirectory_Title
data.value: Product - MigrationFilesRootDirectory

data.name: Product_MigrationFilesRootDirectory_Description
data.value: Path to the root directory containing migration files. Structure: Root/Release_X/TargetGroup/files.sql.

data.name: Product_MigrationFilesRootDirectory_Examples
data.value: ./Migrations/MyApp ../shared-migrations/BackendService C:\Migrations\MyApp (absolute path)

data.name: Product_MigrationFilesRootDirectory_InheritanceNote
data.value: Directory structure must follow: Root/Release_X.Y/TargetGroupAlias/migration_files.sql

data.name: Product_UseCliToolAlias_Title
data.value: Product - UseCliToolAlias

data.name: Product_UseCliToolAlias_Description
data.value: Overrides the default CLI tool alias for this product. References a CLI tool defined in the CliTools section.

data.name: Product_UseCliToolAlias_InheritanceNote
data.value: Overrides the global ProductDefaults.UseCliToolAlias for this product. Applies to all TargetGroups and Targets within this product unless they override it again.

data.name: Product_TargetGroupMigrationOrder_Title
data.value: Product - TargetGroupMigrationOrder

data.name: Product_TargetGroupMigrationOrder_Description
data.value: Defines the execution order of target groups within this product. Specify a comma-separated list of target group aliases. If not set, target groups are executed in the order they appear in the configuration.

data.name: Product_TargetGroupMigrationOrder_Examples
data.value: Backend,Frontend,Reporting

data.name: Product_TargetGroupMigrationOrder_InheritanceNote
data.value: All target group aliases must appear exactly once. This is a product-level setting and cannot be inherited from ProductDefaults.

data.name: TargetGroup_Alias_Title
data.value: Target Group - Alias

data.name: TargetGroup_Alias_Description
data.value: Unique name identifying this target group within the product. Example: Backend, Frontend, Reporting.

data.name: TargetGroup_Alias_Examples

data.name: TargetGroup_DatabaseType_Title
data.value: Target Group - DatabaseType

data.name: TargetGroup_DatabaseType_Description
data.value: Database engine for all targets in this group. All targets must use the same engine.

data.name: TargetGroup_DatabaseType_ValidValues
data.value: SqlServer | PostgreSQL | MariaDb | MySql | Sqlite

data.name: TargetGroup_DatabaseType_InheritanceNote

data.name: TargetGroup_TargetMigrationOrder_Title
data.value: Target Group - TargetMigrationOrder

data.name: TargetGroup_TargetMigrationOrder_Description
data.value: Overrides the default execution order for this group. Simultaneously: file-first. Successively: target-first.

data.name: TargetGroup_TargetMigrationOrder_ValidValues
data.value: Simultaneously | Successively

data.name: TargetGroup_TargetMigrationOrder_InheritanceNote

data.name: TargetGroup_HashValidationScope_Title
data.value: Target Group - HashValidationScope

data.name: TargetGroup_HashValidationScope_Description
data.value: Overrides the default hash validation for this group. File, SqlBlocks, or Disabled.

data.name: TargetGroup_HashValidationScope_ValidValues
data.value: File | SqlBlocks | Disabled

data.name: TargetGroup_HashValidationScope_InheritanceNote
data.value: Overrides the global ProductDefaults.TargetGroupDefaults.HashValidationScope for this specific group.

data.name: TargetGroup_UseCliToolAlias_Title
data.value: Target Group - UseCliToolAlias

data.name: TargetGroup_UseCliToolAlias_Description
data.value: Overrides the CLI tool alias for all targets in this group.

data.name: TargetGroup_UseCliToolAlias_InheritanceNote
data.value: Overrides the Product-level UseCliToolAlias for all targets in this group. Individual targets can still override this.

data.name: Target_Alias_Title
data.value: Target - Alias

data.name: Target_Alias_Description
data.value: Unique name identifying this target within the target group. Example: MainDB, ReplicaDB.

data.name: Target_Alias_Examples

data.name: Target_ConnectionString_Title
data.value: Target - ConnectionString

data.name: Target_ConnectionString_Description
data.value: Connection string to this target database. Use {ENV:VAR_NAME} for sensitive values.

data.name: Target_ConnectionString_Examples
Target_ConnectionString_InheritanceNote
data.value: Use {ENV:VARIABLE_NAME} placeholders for sensitive values. The placeholder is resolved at runtime from environment variables.

data.name: Target_Timeout_Title
data.value: Target - Timeout

data.name: Target_Timeout_Description

data.name: Target_Timeout_InheritanceNote
data.value: Overrides ProductDefaults.TargetGroupDefaults.TargetDefaults.DbCommandTimeoutInSeconds for this specific target.

data.name: Target_MaxRetries_Title
data.value: Target - Max Retries

data.name: Target_MaxRetries_Description
data.value: Overrides the default retry count for this target.

data.name: Target_MaxRetries_InheritanceNote
data.value: Overrides ProductDefaults.TargetGroupDefaults.TargetDefaults.DbCommandMaxRetries for this specific target. Default 0 means no retries for migration commands (unlike the Repository which defaults to 100).

data.name: Target_Wait_Title
data.value: Target - Wait

data.name: Target_Wait_Description
data.value: Overrides the default retry wait time for this target. Value in milliseconds.

data.name: Target_UseCliToolAlias_Title
data.value: Target - UseCliToolAlias

data.name: Target_UseCliToolAlias_Description
data.value: Overrides the CLI tool alias for this specific target.

data.name: Target_UseCliToolAlias_InheritanceNote
data.value: Most specific level in the inheritance chain: ProductDefaults -> Product -> TargetGroup -> Target. If set here, this target uses the specified CLI tool regardless of settings at higher levels.

data.name: Target_CliToolParameters_Title
data.value: Target - CliToolParameters

data.name: Target_CliToolParameters_Description
data.value: Custom key-value parameters resolved into the CLI tool's ArgumentTemplate. Keys like Server, User, Password, Database are replaced in the template.

data.name: Target_CliToolParameters_Examples
data.value:
Server=myserver User=admin Password={ENV:DB_PASSWORD} Database=mydb
These values replace placeholders in the CLI tool's ArgumentTemplate. For example, with template '-S {Server} -U {User} -P {Password} -d {Database} -i "{FilePath}"', the parameters above produce: '-S myserver -U admin -P *** -d mydb -i "migration.sql"'

data.name: Target_CliToolParameters_InheritanceNote
data.value: Only applicable when a CLI tool is assigned to this target (directly or via inheritance). The expected parameter keys depend on the CLI tool's ArgumentTemplate.

data.name: CliTool_Alias_Title
data.value: CLI Tool - Alias

data.name: CliTool_Alias_Description
data.value: Unique name for this CLI tool. Referenced by UseCliToolAlias on Products, TargetGroups, or Targets.

data.name: CliTool_Alias_Examples
data.value: sqlcmd, psql, mariadb-cli, mysql-cli, sqlite3

data.name: CliTool_ExecutablePath_Title
data.value: CLI Tool - ExecutablePath

data.name: CliTool_ExecutablePath_Description
data.value: Path to the CLI tool executable. Can be absolute or relative (if the tool is in PATH).

data.name: CliTool_ExecutablePath_Examples
data.value: sqlcmd (if in PATH) /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd C:\Program Files\Microsoft SQL Server\Client SDK\ODBC\170\Tools\Binn\sqlcmd.exe psql mariadb mysql sqlite3

data.name: CliTool_ArgumentTemplate_Title
data.value: CLI Tool - ArgumentTemplate

data.name: CliTool_ArgumentTemplate_Description
data.value: Command-line argument template with placeholders. {FilePath} is the only system-managed placeholder and is always replaced with the migration file path. All other placeholders (e.g. {Server}, {User}, {Password}, {Database}) are exemplary names — you can use any custom placeholder names. Each placeholder is resolved from the target's CliToolParameters.

data.name: CliTool_ArgumentTemplate_Examples
data.value:
SQL Server (sqlcmd): -S {Server} -U {User} -P {Password} -d {Database} -i "{FilePath}" -C
PostgreSQL (psql): -h {Host} -U {User} -d {Database} -f "{FilePath}"
MariaDB/MySQL: -h {Host} -u {User} -p{Password} {Database}
Sqlite: "{Database}"

data.name: CliTool_ArgumentTemplate_InheritanceNote
data.value: {FilePath} is always replaced with the migration file path. All other placeholders are resolved from the target's CliToolParameters (JSON path: Products[].TargetGroups[].Targets[].CliToolParameters). Each {Name} in the template requires a matching key in CliToolParameters. The placeholder names shown in the examples (Server, User, Password, Database) are only examples — you can define any names you need.

data.name: CliTool_InputMode_Title
data.value: CLI Tool - InputMode

data.name: CliTool_InputMode_Description
data.value: How the SQL file is passed to the CLI tool. File: as a command-line argument. Stdin: piped via standard input.

data.name: CliTool_InputMode_ValidValues
data.value: File | Stdin

data.name: CliTool_InputMode_DefaultValue
data.value: File

data.name: CliTool_InputMode_Examples
data.value: File: The migration file path is passed as a command-line argument via {FilePath}. Stdin: The migration file content is piped into the tool's standard input. Useful for tools that read SQL from stdin (e.g., psql with -f -).

data.name: CliTool_SuccessExitCodes_Title
data.value: CLI Tool - SuccessExitCodes

data.name: CliTool_SuccessExitCodes_Description
data.value: Whitelist of exit codes that indicate successful execution. Any exit code not matched is treated as failure. Supports range notation. Default: ["0"].

data.name: CliTool_SuccessExitCodes_Examples
data.value: Single value: "0" -- matches exit code 0. Closed range: "1..5" -- matches 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. Open-ended up: "10.." -- matches 10, 11, 12, ... Open-ended down: "..-1" -- matches ..., -3, -2, -1. Combined: ["0", "100..110"] -- matches 0 and 100 through 110.

data.name: CliTool_Timeout_Title
data.value: CLI Tool - Timeout

data.name: CliTool_Timeout_Description
data.value: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the CLI tool to complete. Default: 120.

data.name: Serilog_MinimumLevel_Title
data.value: Serilog - MinimumLevel

data.name: Serilog_MinimumLevel_Description
data.value: Default minimum log level for all Serilog sinks. Recommended: Information for production, Debug for development.

data.name: Serilog_MinimumLevel_ValidValues
data.value: Verbose | Debug | Information | Warning | Error | Fatal

data.name: Serilog_MinimumLevel_DefaultValue
data.value: Information

data.name: Serilog_MinimumLevel_InheritanceNote
data.value: Note: Serilog uses different level names than DatabaseLogging. Serilog uses 'Verbose' and 'Fatal', while DatabaseLogging uses 'Trace' and 'Critical'.

data.name: Serilog_SinkName_Title
data.value: Serilog - Sink Name

data.name: Serilog_SinkName_Description
data.value: Name of the Serilog output sink. Common sinks: Console, File.

data.name: Serilog_SinkName_ValidValues
data.value: Console | File | (any installed Serilog sink)

data.name: Serilog_SinkName_DefaultValue
data.value: Console

data.name: Serilog_SinkName_Examples
data.value: Console: Writes to stdout/stderr File: Writes to a log file (configure path in Args)

data.name: DatabaseLogging_TableBaseName_Title
data.value: Database Logging - Table Base Name

data.name: DatabaseLogging_TableBaseName_Description
data.value: Optional prefix for the logging table name. When set, the log table is named {Prefix}MigrationLog instead of MigrationLog. Useful when sharing a schema between the migration repository and the logging table, or when multiple RayMigrator instances log to the same schema.

data.name: DatabaseLogging_TableBaseName_DefaultValue
data.value: "" (empty — default table name MigrationLog is used)

data.name: DatabaseLogging_TableBaseName_Examples
data.value: If set to 'App1_', the log table will be named App1_MigrationLog. If left empty, the default table name MigrationLog is used. Use the same prefix as Repository.TableBaseName to keep table names consistent.

data.name: Serilog_OverrideSource_Title
data.value: Serilog - Override Source Namespace

data.name: Serilog_OverrideSource_Description
data.value: The .NET namespace or class name to apply a custom minimum log level to. This allows you to increase or decrease logging verbosity for specific parts of the application. Common namespaces include Microsoft.*, System.Net.Http, and Raycoon.RayMigrator.*.

data.name: Serilog_OverrideSource_Examples
data.value: Microsoft → suppresses verbose Microsoft framework logs Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore → suppresses EF Core SQL logging System.Net.Http → suppresses HTTP client logs Raycoon.RayMigrator.Services → increases detail for migration service Raycoon.RayMigrator.Database → shows database operation details

data.name: Serilog_OverrideLevel_Title
data.value: Serilog - Override Log Level

data.name: Serilog_OverrideLevel_Description
data.value: The minimum log level to apply to the specified source namespace. Events below this level from the specified namespace are suppressed. This overrides the global MinimumLevel for the matched namespace only.

data.name: Serilog_OverrideLevel_ValidValues
data.value: Verbose | Debug | Information | Warning | Error | Fatal

data.name: Serilog_OverrideLevel_Examples
data.value: Setting Microsoft to Warning suppresses all Info/Debug logs from Microsoft namespaces. Setting Raycoon.RayMigrator to Debug shows detailed diagnostic output for RayMigrator. Setting System.Net.Http to Error suppresses all HTTP traffic logging except errors.

data.name: Serilog_SinkArgs_Title
data.value: Serilog - Sink Arguments

data.name: Serilog_SinkArgs_Description
data.value: Key-value arguments passed to the Serilog sink. The available arguments depend on the sink type. For the Console sink, no arguments are typically needed. For the File sink, configure the output path and rolling policy.

data.name: Serilog_SinkArgs_Examples
data.value:
Console sink: (no args needed)
File sink: path → ./logs/raymigrator-.log rollingInterval → Day retainedFileCountLimit → 30 outputTemplate → {Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} [{Level:u3}] {Message:lj}{NewLine}{Exception}

data.name: Concept_Environment_Title
data.value: What is an Environment?

data.name: Concept_Environment_Description
data.value: An Environment represents a deployment stage of your application, such as Development, Staging, or Production. RayMigrator generates a separate configuration file (appsettings.{Environment}.json) for each environment, allowing you to use different connection strings, log levels, or other settings per stage. For example, your Development environment might point to a local Docker database, while Production connects to your live database server.

data.name: Concept_Environment_Examples
data.value: Development — local development with Docker databases Staging — pre-production testing environment Production — live production environment Docker — containerized test environment

data.name: Concept_TargetGroup_Title
data.value: What is a Target Group?

data.name: Concept_TargetGroup_Description
data.value: A Target Group is a logical grouping of database targets that share the same database engine (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL). A product can have multiple target groups to manage different parts of your application's database landscape. For example, a 'Backend' target group for your main application databases and a 'Frontend' target group for a separate CMS database. All targets within a target group must use the same database type because they share the same migration SQL files. The migration files for each target group are stored in a subdirectory named after the target group alias.

data.name: Concept_TargetGroup_Examples
data.value: Backend — main application databases (e.g., SQL Server) Frontend — CMS or content databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) Reporting — analytics and reporting databases Archive — archival/historical data databases

data.name: Concept_TargetGroup_InheritanceNote
data.value: Each target group has its own subdirectory under the release folder. For example: Migrations/MyApp/Release_1.0/Backend/*.sql

data.name: Concept_Target_Title
data.value: What is a Target?

data.name: Concept_Target_Description
data.value: A Target is a single database instance where migration scripts are applied. A target group can contain multiple targets when you have mirrored, replicated, or load-balanced databases that all need the same schema. For example, if your backend has two mirrored SQL Server databases (BackendDB1 and BackendDB2), you would define both as targets within the same 'Backend' target group. RayMigrator then applies each migration to both databases, ensuring they stay in sync. Each target requires its own connection string.

data.name: Concept_Target_Examples
data.value: BackendDB1 — primary backend database BackendDB2 — mirrored/replicated backend database ReadOnlyDB — read replica for reporting MainDB — single database (simplest setup)
